plugins.name: token-diet
plugins.description: Compact-context tools and guards: code outline, capped search, compact builds, oversized-read blocking, repeated-call detection.

description_i18n.en: Cuts the tokens a coding session spends on file dumps, unbounded greps and raw build logs.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 减少编码会话在整文件读取、无界搜索和原始构建日志上消耗的 token。
